subject: The 2AM mistake that changed everything
preview_text: I accidentally built our most-used feature while half-asleep. Here's the real story.
body_paragraphs: It was 2AM. I had a 10-page paper due in 8 hours and my brain was fried. I'd been staring at a blank screen for three hours, chugging coffee, and my thesis statement was still garbage. I typed something so bad I laughed out loud — then accidentally hit 'enter' on a test script I'd been coding for weeks.

That script did something weird: it took my half-formed idea and turned it into a solid argument. Not perfect, but good enough to stop the panic. I submitted it, got an A-, and realized I'd stumbled onto something. The next morning, I cleaned up the code and named it 'Instant Thesis' — now the most-used feature in the app.

I built Thesis Generator for that exact 2AM moment — when you're out of time and your brain won't cooperate. Open the app right now and tap 'Instant Thesis.' Drop in a topic, any topic, and watch it generate a strong, citation-ready thesis in under 10 seconds. No staring, no second-guessing.

You already have the app. Just open it and try one thesis. That's it. P.S. — The humanize feature was born the same week, after I got flagged by Turnitin. Tap the 'Humanize' button after your thesis is ready — it rewrites your text to sound like you actually wrote it at 2PM.
